name: Adelaide Plains
terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A South Australian region just north of Adelaide, in the Mount Lofty Ranges zone. Shiraz is 39 percent of plantings, followed by Cabernet Sauvignon at 14 percent.
